milestones.name: D810 SDK and WPD readiness
milestones.completion_contract: Version 2.6 requirements define explicit SingleCamera and DualCamera without automatic fallback while the native Phase 0 harness, SDK acceptance workflow, approved single-slot spool, fake-only legacy capture commands, operator-session-wide camera lease, transaction watchdog, Live View handoff, and redacted evidence contracts remain ready.

milestones.name: Single D810 non-destructive verification
milestones.completion_contract: Exactly one D810 passes redacted SDK/WPD inventory under an explicitly approved documented identity strategy, required continuity evidence, principal setting readback, and a native command-trace contract without photographic-setting writes or capture; the identity-v2 collision is not persistent Dual identity and Dual instead follows the ADR-0025 session-local operator binding contract; physical power-cycle is N/A by the 2026-08-09 decision.

milestones.name: SingleCamera physical capture and Live View Phase 0
milestones.completion_contract: For this request use ADR-0030: at most five first-attempt SingleCamera transactions including the initial one-shot, verified canonical originals, exact-object cleanup, selected-camera Live View handoff and separate fault evidence. Preserve historical 1/10/100 results. WPF acceptance remains separately evidenced.

milestones.name: Dual D810 sequential hybrid Phase 0
milestones.completion_contract: After software contracts, current exact-two identity, explicit CAM-A/B binding, pair preflight, SDK-source close and ADR-0028 coexistence checks, accept at most five first-attempt CaptureRecoveryOnly pairs including the first one-shot. Stop at first failure, ambiguity, binding loss or insufficient host budget. No supplemental 10/100 stage or production hundred-run wiring is required under ADR-0030. Preserve originals, no retry, no SDK/WPD overlap, exact-object cleanup and the 180-second watchdog. Record all durations and maximum; performance review and separate fault evidence remain. CaptureRecoveryOnly does not establish A0 quality or shutter synchronization.

milestones.name: Offline pre-gate foundations
milestones.completion_contract: Parameterized optical math, synthetic fixture contracts, versioned rig-profile schema, three-state setup assessment, and synthetic measurement-to-bounded-correction contracts pass without claiming an approved rig or A0 quality result.

milestones.name: D810 offline planar stitching PoC
milestones.completion_contract: Approved D810 optical fixture and rig profile meet setup, bounded automatic correction, geometry, color, seam, crop, memory, and timing criteria.

milestones.name: Simulated mode-aware integration foundations
milestones.completion_contract: Versioned application/IPC contracts and explicit SingleCamera and DualCamera fake workflows pass, including no automatic fallback, SingleCamera one-original export with Stitch NotApplicable, and DualCamera sequential pairing, while remaining visibly simulated and unconnected to real hardware.

milestones.name: 2026-08-26 controlled SingleCamera test readiness
milestones.completion_contract: A clean exact-SHA Windows candidate records the 2026-08-25 product-owner waiver of automated test execution, passes the required manual software smoke, exposes a truthful SingleCamera test flow, keeps incomplete Dual hardware paths blocked, and is ready for an operator-controlled exactly-one D810 read-only preflight followed by at most one initial no-retry capture after empty dedicated spool proof. The waiver is not a software PASS, MVP acceptance, release evidence, or hardware acceptance. Completion means internal test readiness only and does not complete M1A, M3, M4, Dual hardware acceptance, A0 quality acceptance, or release.

milestones.name: Integrated mode-aware MVP
milestones.completion_contract: One operation follows the explicit immutable mode: SingleCamera captures and explicitly exports one canonical original without stitching; DualCamera captures CAM-A then CAM-B and stitches; both preserve evidence and fail safely without automatic fallback or retry.

milestones.name: Acceptance and packaging
milestones.completion_contract: Acceptance, durability, redistribution, installer, and release gates are approved.
